{"id":1921514225,"question_id":190,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"5 months","timestamp":1771276871,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1921514225/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Reverse Bits","memory":"8.1 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int reverseBits(int n) {\n        if(n == 0) return 0;\n\n        int ans = 0;\n        for(int i = 1 ; i<=32 ; i++)\n        {\n            int lsb = n & 1;\n            ans <<= 1;\n            ans = ans | lsb;\n            n >>= 1;\n        }\n    return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"reverse-bits","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1716}
